title: Individuals and Organisations Prosecuted for Illegal Shipment of Elephant Ivory and Pangolin Scales in 2019
what_it_is: Individuals and Organisations Prosecuted for Illegal Shipment of Elephant Ivory and Pangolin Scales in 2019

sections.label: Pangolin scale seizures and China arrests
sections.summary: Singapore seized three pangolin scale shipments in 2019, worked with China and international bodies, and China arrested 14 suspects.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: In 2019, three shipments of pangolin scales, two of which also contained elephant ivory, were seized in Singapore en route from Africa to Vietnam.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: As the cases involve entities outside of Singapore, the National Parks Board (NParks) has been working closely with the source and destination countries, as well as sharing information with international organisations, such as the Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora (CITES), as well as the International Criminal Police Organization (INTERPOL).

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: China was established to be the intended final destination country for these shipments.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Our collaboration with China in relation to these cases has led to the arrests of 14 suspected criminals by Chinese authorities.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: NParks will continue to assist with international investigations into these cases.

sections.label: Sharing evidence with Chinese authorities
sections.summary: NParks will surface evidence it finds to Chinese authorities and the relevant international authority investigating the cases.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: As and when they pick up any clues – the Member mentioned money trails – if they come across any evidence that would help the Chinese authorities, in this case, get better inputs into who the criminals behind this are, they will surface it to the Chinese authorities.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: So, yes, there is collaboration and when we come across evidence, we will surface to the relevant international authority that is looking into it.

sections.label: Financial institutions surfacing related monies
sections.summary: Monies related to money laundering or trafficking would be surfaced by Singapore's financial institutions to aid investigations.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: If there are monies that are related, be it money laundering or trafficking, this, indeed, would be surfaced by our financial institutions to aid investigations.
